run_create_voc_data_files: run the CLI to extract VOC2007/VOC2012 dataset files and save numpy arrays for train/test splits
build_prepare_voc_partitions: build VOC dataset numpy files with separate train, val, and test partitions from ImageSets annotations
create_generate_voc_json: create VOC dataset JSON target files mapping image IDs to per-class presence labels
test_validate_voc_files: test the validate_files function to filter VOC annotation files matching the class_split.txt naming pattern
summarize_get_images_labels_info: summarize the get_images_labels_info function that maps image names to multi-class label vectors
